lines.en: I bounce along behind you
My two eyes are different sizes
The chest on my back sways
I catch up in hops
I hop ahead and wait for you

lines.zh: 我的身体在动，箱子也动
lines.en: My body moves, and so does the chest
I hop over a stone
I follow softly, so I don't disturb you

lines.zh: 我绕着你小腿打了个转
lines.en: I circle once around your shin

lines.zh: 我的脚步把我的箱子颠得响
lines.en: My steps rattle the chest on my back
I squeeze through between your legs

lines.zh: 我在这儿等你，别丢下我
lines.en: I am waiting here, do not leave me behind
I settle in beside your boots

lines.zh: 我的箱子盖轻轻动了一下
lines.en: My chest lid moves slightly
I tilt my head until you look
I wait for you to open the chest
My eyes roll this way and that

lines.zh: 我趴在箱盖上一动不动
lines.en: I lie on the lid without moving
My body is like a soft sack
I listen to you sorting your things
The chest is a little heavy
I bounce once in place
I lie down beside the chest
I lift the lid a crack
I am counting what is inside
I rest my head on the edge of the chest
I wait for you to come back for something
I doze, puffing in and out
Do you want something out of it

lines.zh: 我的箱子一直开着等你
lines.en: My chest is always open for you
I am your carrying chest
What you put in is all there
I only follow you
You move and I move
Do not close the chest and forget to open it
I look at you very earnestly
Ask me if you need anything
I crouch here until you call
I belong to you alone

lines.zh: 我把箱子往前推了一点
lines.en: I push the chest forward a little
I wait for you to open me
That will not fit in one slot
My chest was knocked crooked
I hopped a little away
I do not much mind this wound
My lid got bent out of shape
I shake myself; the clasp holds
I am not squashed yet
A thing this size does not come apart easily
I shrink behind you
Something inside shifted
I will still follow you

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我能装下它
lines.en: I do not eat, but I can hold it
You hold that up, it is no use to me
Perhaps there is some in my chest
Do you want to put it in
I can fit this
It is smaller than my chest
Put it in and I will go

lines.zh: 我不需要，但你可以留着
lines.en: I do not need it, but you can keep it

lines.zh: 你手上那东西，箱子装得下
lines.en: That thing in your hand would fit inside me
Do not hand it to me yet
You bumped my chest
I hop half a step to make room

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我弹开了
lines.en: We collided, I bounced off
My chest lid clattered
I wobbled before steadying
Your boot sole pins my toes
I shuffle around the other side of the chest
I am fine like this
Did any of your things fall out
I press close to your leg again
I am your chest
Your pack is all I need
Carrying me along is enough
I cannot work this out
I follow only one person
I poke my head out past the chest
I bounce twice in place
I have no answer for that

lines.zh: 我的箱子盖自己合了一下
lines.en: My lid closed itself once
I fall back in behind you
I pick it up in my mouth
This goes in the chest

lines.zh: 我把它顶开盖子塞进去
lines.en: I nudge the lid open and stuff it in
I have put away what you dropped
I carry it to the chest
This is a little too big
I try to fit it in
It fell out, I try again

lines.zh: 这东西我推到你的鞋尖
lines.en: I nudge it to the tip of your boot
This should be your decision
Something is approaching us
I put the chest in front of you
I stand at your side
My eyes are fixed that way
I am not a fighter
But while you are here I must protect
I nudge your boot heel
I ready myself to hide behind you
That presence is behind me
I watch it without moving
I snap the lid shut
I keep close to your leg
I hold the lid in front of me

lines.zh: 我小声叫了一下，提醒你
lines.en: I cry softly to warn you
I stay right beside you
It circles, I turn too
My chest is a little in the way
I drag the chest behind you
You retreat and I retreat
I watch the foot it steps with
I dare not cry too loudly

lines.zh: 再近一点我就跳到你后面
lines.en: Any closer and I hop behind you

lines.zh: 我抓紧箱带挡在你身前
lines.en: I grip my strap and stand before you
I will not go unless you go

lines.zh: 我的箱子在地上拖出声音
lines.en: My chest scrapes the ground

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，躲在你后面
lines.en: I keep low, hiding behind you
I turn the chest sideways to block the way
I wait for you to decide
It is on my side now
I ram it with the chest
I leap up and press down
The chest corner clipped it
That only clattered the chest
I hop back to your side
I only wanted it to back off
I shove the chest at its feet

lines.zh: 我把箱子的一角顶过去
lines.en: I jab with a corner of the chest
I drive my chest's base into its knee
I shrink back after the bump
I am a chest that was summoned

lines.zh: 我落地的时候箱子还在背上
lines.en: My chest was still on my back when I landed
I acknowledge only one master
I come to your side
My chest is empty, waiting for you
I do not spawn naturally
I hop twice to show I am here
I am summoned out of nothing
The moment I land I look for you
My chest is heavier than I am
I run to your feet

lines.zh: 这一片我不熟，但我认得你
lines.en: I do not know this place, but I know you
My lid popped open by itself

lines.zh: 我等你给我第一个东西
lines.en: I wait for you to give me the first thing

lines.zh: 火烧到我的箱子，木头在响
lines.en: Fire caught the chest, the wood is crackling

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，箱子先着地
lines.en: I fell from height and the chest landed first
Water seeps in through the chest seams

lines.zh: 气浪把我和箱子一起掀翻
lines.en: The blast flipped me and the chest together

lines.zh: 有东西打在我的箱子上
lines.en: Something struck my chest

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的身体发抖
lines.en: That magic made my body shiver
I am a chest, I do not need to eat
Lightning struck my chest

lines.zh: 我的箱子和地一起不见了
lines.en: My chest and the ground are both gone
